symbols.name: prime source length
symbols.meaning: The $i$-th prime source length, an odd prime chosen close to the padded axis length $t_i$.
symbols.quote: Here $s_i$ is the $i$-th prime source length, an odd prime, and $t_i$ is the $i$-th padded axis length, a power of two.

symbols.name: padded axis length
symbols.meaning: The $i$-th padded axis length, a power of two.
symbols.quote: Here $s_i$ is the $i$-th prime source length, an odd prime, and $t_i$ is the $i$-th padded axis length, a power of two.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: The index of an axis, so that $s_i$ and $t_i$ belong to the same axis.
symbols.quote: Here $s_i$ is the $i$-th prime source length, an odd prime, and $t_i$ is the $i$-th padded axis length, a power of two.

symbols.name: window width constant
symbols.meaning: A fixed constant with $0<\eta<1/4$ that sets the width of the window.
symbols.quote: where the constant $\eta$, with $0<\eta<1/4$, sets the width of the window.

relations.quote: Second, the ratio $t_i/s_i$ must leave enough separation for [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md), which moves between transforms of length $s_i$ and of length $t_i$.

Since the $s_i$ are distinct primes, they are pairwise coprime, so they supply axis lengths to the [Chinese-remainder map](chinese-remainder-map.md), which turns one cyclic convolution into a multidimensional one.
